bio.text: Anthony DeLuca is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 80th District, serving since March 2009, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

DeLuca's legislature biography says DeLuca was mayor of Chicago Heights from 2003 to 2009 and a member and president of the Bloom Township High School District 206 Board of Education from 1995 to 2003.
It says DeLuca has worked in sales for Republic Services since 2012, was director of operations at Skyline Disposal Company from 1987 to 2012, and graduated from Elmhurst College.
